items.title: Stroud Honored By Sun Belt Conference
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS - Georgia Southern fifth-year outside linebacker MJ Stroud was named the Sun Belt Conference Defensive Player of the Week for his play at Troy on Saturday.

items.title: Defense Posts Historic Numbers In Big Win at Troy
items.summary: TROY, Ala. — Behind a historic effort from its defense, Georgia Southern (7-4, 6-1) scored the final 24 points and defeated Troy (4-7, 2-5) 45-7 on Saturday at Veterans Memorial Stadium.

items.title: The Extra Down: Diego Aviles Turned Patience Into Opportunity
items.summary: For fifth-year linebacker Diego Aviles, the road to Georgia Southern football was anything but conventional. A lifelong basketball player, Aviles didn't begin taking football seriously until his junior year of high school.

items.title: GAME PREVIEW: Eagles Look to Continue Hot Streak at Troy
items.summary: STATESBORO - The Georgia Southern football squad hits the road for the second straight week as it travels to Alabama to take on Troy in Sun Belt Conference action.

items.title: Eagles Earn Bowl Eligibility With 34-17 Win Over Georgia State
items.summary: ATLANTA - Georgia Southern won all three phases of the game en route to a convincing 34-17 win over Georgia State Saturday at Center Parc Stadium to gain bowl eligibility for the fifth straight year and win the Georgia Grown Bowl for the third straight time.

items.title: The Extra Down: The Work Behind Anthony Bynum's Rise
items.summary: Before becoming a defensive leader at Georgia Southern, fourth-year outside linebacker Anthony Bynum spent much of his high school career waiting for his opportunity.

items.title: GAME PREVIEW: In-State Bragging Rights on the Line in Atlanta
items.summary: STATESBORO - In-state rivals meet Saturday in Atlanta as the Georgia Southern football squad takes hits the road to take on Georgia State in Sun Belt Conference action.

items.title: Max Johnson Honored by Sun Belt
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS - Georgia Southern seventh-year quarterback Max Johnson was named the Sun Belt Conference Offensive Player of the Week for his play against Marshall.

items.title: Johnson Leads Eagles to Big Win Over Marshall
items.summary: STATESBORO — Georgia Southern (5-4, 4-1) defeated 49-13 Marshall (5-4, 2-3) on Saturday at Allen E. Paulson Stadium, highlighted by 35 unanswered points across five scoring drives.

items.title: The Extra Down: Built on Belief David Mbadinga's Journey From Walk-On to Leader
items.summary: Fourth-year running back David Mbadinga has never been short on belief. Long before earning opportunities in the Georgia Southern backfield or envisioning a future in software engineering, Mbadinga had to learn the value of patience and perseverance.
